tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ba ri lugs kyi bum chog byad 'grol gyi yi ge shel gyi sbur len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo badzra ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā yai/ drag sngags me zer phog tsam gyis// byad gtad ma lus sreg byed pa'i// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro la// btud nas byad 'grol cho ga bri// 'di la sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril ḍa ma ru nang mchod bsham/ stegs kyi khar bum pa bcud ldan chas su bcug pa bkod/ mdun du gtor ma dkar zlum dang mthar mchod pas bskor/ de'i shar ram phyogs ji ltar bde bar zhi ba'i me thab spyi mthun grub na legs/ bsdu na zangs lcags la sogs pa'i snod du chos 'byung mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshon spungs sngon po dgod/ mtha' nas bud shing zlum por brtsigs/ bsreg rdzas mar khu/ seng ldeng dam rgya shug gi yam shing*/ 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang glud gzugs gcig changs bu nyer gcig yos dang 'bru dkar bsres pa/ sbyong ba'i chas/ byabs rdzas bdun/ stan dkar gsar pa/ tshon skud sna lnga ring po bsrung bya'i grangs mnyam/ gri rnon po gsar pa rnams tshogs par bya'o// dngos gzhi'i thog mar bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu sdang bar paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas byas te/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du pad nyi la dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ro'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang skur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bhā ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas/

shabda āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlab/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ sogs nas shabda'i bar dang*/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ aḥkaḥs maḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzlas mthar/ ri khrus nas 'byung ba'i khrus sngags kyang ci nus bzlas la/ slar yang mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtong ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags sam sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te/ lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// de nas bsgrub bya rnams kyi mdun du sbyong chas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ las kyi rdo rjes bsgrub bya rnams la g.yas phyogs su bskor zhing*/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bighān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs brjod de se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la zhi bas sbyang*/ de bzhin du ting lo dang changs bu bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje gsor zhing aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs snying po brjod pa lan gsum gyi mthar/

'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ khro bo spyan 'dren gdan 'bul mchod bstod rnams byas pa'i mthar/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des mgu bar gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos aḥkaḥsogs zlo zhing rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brabs la slar yang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing sogs kyi mthar rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs sbyar ba lan gnyis te drag po'i sbyang ba lan gsum bya'o// de nas bsgrub byar tshon skud sna lnga grol mdud kyi a long lnga byas la dbus kyi che ba de ske la bskon/

g.yas kyi gnyis lag pa dang rkang pa g.yas kyi srin mdzub la bskon/ g.yon gnyis kyang de ltar bya/ skye bo mang po la de ltar ma 'grub na tshon skud gcig gis thams cad kyi srin mdzub la sbrel yang rung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag sogs nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bsgrub bya 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa phyi rol 'jig rten kyi khams dang nang lus la gnas pa thams cad zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus drangs shing*/ gzhan yang sdig sgrib nad gdon byur chag skal ba ngan pa thams cad bkug ste byad thag 'di la thim/ khyad par du yang sa las byung ba bad kan gyi nad rnams tshon skud ser po la thim/ chu las gyur pa grang ba'i nad rnams dkar po la thim/ me las gyur pa khrag mkhris rnams dmar po la thim/ rlung las gyur pa rlung gi nad rnams sngon po la thim/ 'byung ba sna tshogs 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ ldan pa dang*/ 'dus pa'i nad rnams ljang gu la thim par gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ drang srong rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di dag la 'tshe bar byed pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/

nad dang gdon dang bgegs dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ byad ma byur chag skal ba ngan pa/ dus kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log 'dren mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshon skud sna lnga pa 'di la thim par gyur cig ṭākki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang bcas te bya/ de nas gri gug me dang chur rim gyis bcug ste/ aḥkaḥsogs sngags bzla zhing*/ 'di skad ces/ las kyi slob dpon mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyi skur gyur pa'i phyag g.yas su ral gri thogs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i ngo bo byad thag de dum bur gtubs par mos pa mdzod/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin ded dpon dbang phyug dang*// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*// de dang mthu dang gzi brjid kyis// deng 'dir bsgrub bya 'di dag gi /byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig /sarba bandha kā khordha tstshe da nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing tshon skud rnams yan lag lnga la bskon pa'i sa nas mtshon kha phar gtad de bcad/ de bsgrub bya'i lus la bskor nas/ rdo rje slob ma'am bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes lan mang du brjod de snod gcig tu bsag de nas thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab khung dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su pad nyi la dgra bgegs sogs nas/ mchod bstod bar bum chog bzhin byas mthar/ mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'bar/

bsgrub bya 'di rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs par gyur/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*// me yis bud shing bsregs pa dang*// rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang*// nyi mas nags tshal skems byed dang*// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis// byad stems las rnams tshig par shog /sarba bhandha kā khordha ya dzwa lā ya swā hā/ dang por aḥkaḥsogs kyi mthar/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes btags pas mar khu phul/ 'di dgang blugs kyis phul na legs mod/ ma 'byor na snod ci bde bas phul/ aḥkaḥsogs kyis yam shing yang phul/ de nas slob dpon gyi 'bru sna sna tshogs nas 'bru tshom re 'bul ba dang*/ mchod g.yog pas sngar gyi tshon skud kyi ro de dum bu mang por gtubs/ tsho nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bcos nas tshon skud tsho re dang*/ changs bu re lag pa g.yas g.yon so sor bzung nas bsgrub bya la bskor ba'i tshul byas nas me la 'bul zhing*/ sngags lan nyer gcig brjod pa'am/ bsdu na tshar gcig gi mthar/ bsgrub bya che ge mo'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byad ka rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshig par gyur cig shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig dang*/ de rjes aḥkaḥsogs kho na la las sngags de nyid btags pa'i nyi shus 'bul/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// zhes pa nas/ kā khordha dzwa lā ya swā hā/ bsgrub bya che ge mo'i nad gdon nas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes me dang bsgrub bya la bum chu gtor/ me'i dbal zhi bar gyur/ gong bzhin mar dang yam shing phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig dang*/ 'dod gsol bya/ yig brgya bzod gsol spyi dang 'dra/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas khrus bya ba'i thog mar rten la lha khrus/ sku phyi/ gos 'bul ba'i bar spyi ltar bya/ khrus chu de las bum du blugs pa slob dpon gyis thogs te thog mar ku shas bum chu blangs te bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas gtor/

de rjes khrus byar gzhug cing*/ sngags mthar sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ gdon/ rims/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ 'khon/ grib dang mi gtsang ba/ byad ka byur/ skal ba ngan pa/ gzhan gyi mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa/ rbod gtong*/ ro langs kyi las/ gdon gyi las/ mnan pa dang 'ching ba'i las/ bsregs pa dang phur bus btab pa/ sems g.yeng ba dang sgyur bar byed pa/ sngags dang rdzas ngan pa'i las/ 'khrul 'khor dang mkhyud spyad ngan pa/ bza' nyes dang 'gom nyes la sogs pa/ gzhan gyis las ngan pa byas pa/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ lo keg zla keg zhag keg dus keg chag che nyam nga*/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i gnod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba/ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon/ dus kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa/ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa/ bdud dang mdangs 'phrog gi gnod pa/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas dug zhi bar byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// mau gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// kauṇḍi n+ya yi sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*// tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po'i stobs rnams dang*// sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*// de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis// bsgrub bya'i dug ni dug med shog

/dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /sngags brjod/ syā dya the dan/ ha ri ke shi na ki li ri hi ri a ma ri aṇḍa re/ paṇḍa re/ ke yū re/ ha se ha se/ ha re/ kha se kha se/ me ru ga te na swā hā/ mu mukṣu swā hā/ hi le swā hā/ mi le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*// g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*// lhog pa dag dang g.ya' ba ni// bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum yin// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// de bzhin/ bcom ldan dam chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= ces 'don pa spo'o/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yis su// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// de bzhin chu me rlung rnams la'ang 'don pa spo'o// de nas byabs pa ni/ byabs pa'i rdzas bdun grags pa ku sha/ rma bya'i mdongs/ bya rog gi dong ru/ yungs kar gong bu/ me long*/ ral gri/ dar tshon sna lnga rnams lag tu thogs/ sngar gyi khrus sder dri khu dang bcas pa'i nang du glud gzugs gcig bcug bsgrub bya'i kha ru bum chu cung zad 'dzin du bcug la/ sngags mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes sogs gong dang 'dra ba la shāntiṃ ku ru zhes pa'i bar a pa na ya zhes 'don pa spos la byabs pa'i mthar/ bsgrub bya de nyid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs phra zhing phra ba rus la zhen pa thams cad nag bun gyis skyugs nas glud gzugs la thim par mos shig byas la/ kha nang gi bum chu glud gzugs la pho/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma'am bsgrub bya 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log 'dren mi mthun par byed pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces yungs kar gyis brab/

gu gul gyis bdug drag sngags dang rol chen gyis mtshams gcad do// khrus khu dang glud gzugs chu bo'am gzhi mdor bskyal/ de nas rgyal ba brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las so// dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba las rgyal lo// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur// rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pas rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags// sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham// phyir rgol kun las rgyal bar gyur// swā hā/ bsgrub bya rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ oṃ dza ye bi dza ye swā hā/ dza ya dza ya zhes brjod cing gdan dkar po gsal pa me tog dkar po gsal pas gtor ba la bzhag de nas srung ba ni/ slob dpon gyis bsgrub bya'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas rdo rje'i go bskon par mos te/ sngags mthar sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ zhes sogs gong bkru byab kyi sngags rnams la rakṣa zhes 'don pa spo'o// mthar kha zas kyis srung ba ni/ 'brang rgyas dkar po sbyin pa'am 'o ma la sman sna btab pa khar sbyin te/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan gyur dang 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog

/de la ni kha zas kyi srung ba zhes zer te dga' ston gyi tshul lo// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang med pa'am/ rkang pa gnyis pa'am/ rkang pa bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshogs pa'am/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o// mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// nad rims bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ces pa ni bden stobs brjod pas bsrung ba'o// de nas rang ngam bsgrub bya la me tog 'thor te/ ston mchog dam pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni rgyal ba sogs brjod de bkra shis brjod pas bsrung*/ bsngo smon byas la grol/ slob dpon gyis bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ nongs bshags yig brgya bzla/ bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// de las cung zad 'bring du bya bar 'dod na/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du stegs khebs sogs bkram pa'i khar 'bru'i tshom du bkod pa'am/

bum gdan padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings sngon po'i nang du sum gnyis chus gang ba la rdzas nyer lnga btab pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags la bzhag mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba rnams bshams/ 'og tu bsgrub bya la dgos pa'i mi du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshon skud sna lnga 'dom re/ sla nga chu thub kyi nang du skyer pa skam po phra mo gshags pa'i hom khung gru gsum brtsigs la/ gtor ma gsum/ theb kyu gsum/ changs bu gsum rnams dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog gi snod/ yungs kar/ gu gul rnams sta gon byas la/ rang stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bdag bskyed thar paṇa gyi yig cha ltar dang*/ bum pa bsangs sbyang ba nas chu dang gnyis su med par gyur bar gong ltar bya/ de nas sbyin bdag sogs mdun du bos la sngar gyi tshon skud la lag len ltar mdud pa btab pa bsgrub bya'i ske la bskon/ de nas lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis kyi srin lag la'ang bskon/ sbyong chas mdun du bshams pa chus bran la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag pos sbyong ba rnams gong ltar/ de nas byad 'grol bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa de nyid lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo zhags pa nag po re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'od zer gyi sna la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa thams cad kyi snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/

mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdor dril dang bcas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po 'di nyid la sib sib thim par gyur cig oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥlan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang nas mar song bas/ lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i bar chad thams cad kyang phyir drangs nas so so'i lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid la thim par gyur/ de lta bu'i zhags pa slob dpon ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal bas me dang chur ngar blud pa'i ral gris dum bur gtubs pas gnod byed gdon bgegs byad phur rbod gtong thams cad tshar gcod pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la ral gri me dang chus ngar blud pas lag len ltar bcad cing ngag tu/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon 'gegs thams cad dang*/

mi dang mi ma yin pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do*// mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rigs sngags thams cad gcad do// tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rigs sngags thams cad gcad do// sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// nam mkha' lding dang lha chen po dang nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// srung bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// bhṛṅgi ri ṭi dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// pho nya dang pho nya mos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// drang srong gi tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// lha'i tshogs thams cad kyi byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// mi phan par 'dod pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// zhes dum bur gtub/ de nas spro na shog bur ling gzugs dod par bris pa mdun du bzhag rje btsun sogs gong ltar gyi gnod par byed pa'i byad kha rbod gtong dang bcas pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlan gsum/ phur bu ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gong ltar bskyed nas/ de lta bu'i phur bu lag pas bsgril la liṅgar gdab cing*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad dang mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// de bzhin du/ kun tu rgyus byas pa'i sogs nas/ mi phan par 'dod pas byas pa'i bar re re bzhin gyi mthar/ rig sngags thams cad gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// zhes sbyar/ de nas gong gi tshon skud kyi dum bu dang ling ro yod na de dang bcas pa mdun du bsham/ sngar gyi sla nga'i hom la me sbar/ bum chu gtor/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya tshad yongs su ma chad pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sogs nas/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// bar bum bskyed ltar bya/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sku las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad byad kha rbod gtong thams cad lhag med du bsregs par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spos dang me tog yungs kar dang bcas pa dang*/ tshon skud liṅga dang bcas pa bsgrub bya la bskor zhing*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ zhes pa'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar me nang du phul la/ re re'i mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i bar chad gdon bgegs byad byur mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes brjod/ slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥthab kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ rten la khrus gsol ba gong ltar byas nas/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bum pa'i nang du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can bzhugs pa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad bkrus pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi sham du/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rims nyin gcig pa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rims kyi gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ ldan pa las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ lha'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas su mdangs 'phrog pa dang*/ gzi byin 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su mngal za ba la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dug gi 'jigs pa thams cad= mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad= pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad= dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad= dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas byab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal ba'i phyag gi rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rdo khab len gyis khab len pa'am/

shel sbur len gyis sbur len pa ltar tsen gyis blangs te phyi'i rgya mtsho chen por dor ba'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ khar bum chu 'dzin du bcug kha rgyan gyis byab pa'i tshul byas la sngags kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā'i bar sngar gyi rigs 'gres sbyar/ mthar kha'i chu sla nga'i nang du pho/ de nas chu des bsgrub bya la bskor nas sbyin sreg gi thal ba'i nang du blugs/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= khyad par du'ang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces rol mo drag po bya zhing skyel du gtong*/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor ba dang bcas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal sogs nas/ bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags bar gong ltar la mthar/ dza ya dza ya bi dza ya bi dza ya/ zhes brjod/ de nas sngags kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣaḥ rims nyin gcig pa la sogs pa nas/ shāntiṃ gi gnas su rakṣa rakṣaḥbatags pas bsrung*/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// mkha' 'gro seng gdong can gyi mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces dang*/ che ba'i che mchog lta bu mdo rgyud las byung ba'i bkra shis ci rigs pa byas la bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su gtang zhing*/

mjug gong dang 'dra'o// zhes pa'ang rje bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi bka'i rjes su gnang ba thob par brten/ 'jam mgon bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho can gyi gsung la gzhi byas te blo gter dbang pos bkod pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
